column3: The backend-neutral accelerator operation policy is implemented and tested ahead of the 0.0.9 accelerator release, but no production artifact constructor installs its capability worker pool in the 0.0.7 runtime closure.
column4: Wire the runtime through the selected 0.0.9 accelerator artifact assembly and remove this row before closing AC7 or AC8.

column3: The unified readiness-order model is exercised only by VM conformance tests; production transports still enter their VM-owned resource paths directly.
column4: Wire protocol wake producers through the unified reactor before claiming a single production readiness loop.

column3: The external I/O ownership policy is currently a test-only admission model rather than an enforced production constructor boundary.
column4: Make every maintained host I/O adapter validate this policy at its production creation boundary.

column4: Unify production TCP wake delivery with the scheduler adapter or remove the redundant model after equivalent ownership checks exist.
